claim: ENVI 5.6 (IDL 8.8) supports automated headless task discovery and execution via envipyengine and taskengine.exe (240 tasks observed on host); execution requires verifying process exit code, stderr, and output .dat/.hdr file pair creation rather than process launch alone.
preconditions: ENVI_ENGINE points to C:\Program Files\Harris\ENVI56\IDL88\bin\bin.x86_64\taskengine.exe or valid ENVI 5.6 installation
Valid ENVI license checked out at runtime
limitations: Task enumeration (240 tasks) does not prove individual task parameter compatibility or license availability for specialized modules
ENVI Classic menu functions without modern ENVITask wrappers must be registered separately

claim: ENVI Maximum Likelihood Classification (MaximumLikelihoodClassification) assumes multivariate Gaussian class distributions, requires training sample count per class strictly greater than band count (n > B + 1) for non-singular covariance matrices, and uses probability_threshold (default none/0) and data_scale_factor (e.g. 255 for 0-100 byte reflectance).
source_locator: ENVI Classification Help: Maximum Likelihood & Experiment 8 Section 3
preconditions: Training ROIs mapped to explicit native_code and semantic_id
Each class covariance matrix is positive-definite
Effective probability_threshold (none vs per-class quantile) explicitly frozen in plan
limitations: Rule images store discriminant scores rather than calibrated posterior probabilities
Small training classes (such as n=19 water pixels in Ex8) suffer covariance instability and severe omission on complex backgrounds

claim: ENVI Parallelepiped Classification (ParallelepipedClassification) classifies pixels within mean +/- k*std (typically 3 sigma) per band; overlapping hyper-rectangles depend on class evaluation order or overlap-rejection policy, which must never be mixed across comparisons.
source_locator: ENVI Classification Help: Parallelepiped & MATLAB/ENVI Archive Comparison
preconditions: Per-class standard deviation multiplier (e.g. 3.0) and overlap resolution rule explicitly recorded
limitations: Axis-aligned hyper-boxes ignore inter-band covariance, causing heavy over-assignment to broad-variance classes (e.g. 79.07% cropland in Ex8)

claim: ENVI ISODATA Classification (ISODATAClassification) iteratively clusters pixels using min/max classes, max_iterations, change_threshold, min_pixels_per_class, split_std, and merge_distance; raw output cluster codes carry no land-cover semantics until post-classification ROI mapping is applied.
source_locator: ENVI ISODATAClassification Task & Ball and Hall (1965)
preconditions: Number of classes range, change threshold, and maximum iterations specified
Post-clustering cluster-to-landcover mapping table explicitly saved if semantic accuracy is evaluated
limitations: With max_iterations=1, split and merge dynamics are not exercised
Cluster-to-ROI majority assignment uses training labels and therefore is not purely unsupervised semantic recognition

claim: ENVI native post-processing (Majority/Minority Analysis, ClassificationSieve, ClassificationClump) uses internal tie-breaking, neighborhood connectivity (4 vs 8), and class-specific morphological rules that match custom Python/MATLAB implementations at 98.96%-99.89% rather than 100%; native outputs must be verified directly.
source_locator: ENVI ClassificationPostProcessing Help & Experiment 8 Section 6 Rule 10
preconditions: Input is a discrete classification raster with explicit class coding
Kernel size (e.g. 3x3), center weight, connectivity (4 or 8), and minimum sieve size (e.g. 5 or 6 pixels) specified
limitations: Clump on a single confused class (e.g. water 3x3/5x5) aggressively expands that class into adjacent confused classes (35,739 -> 70,186 / 113,060 pixels)
Majority smoothing can erode narrow linear water features even when sample OA remains unchanged

claim: Custom morphological closing / hole-filling post-processing in MATLAB or Python is a mathematical approximation (implementation_kind=approximation) and is not bit-identical to ENVI native ClassificationClump or standard morphological closing across multi-class boundaries.
source_locator: MATLAB Archive Record Section 实际流程与配置 (Item 4) & ENVI Ex8 Rule 10
preconditions: Must be explicitly labeled implementation_kind=approximation in plan and report
Cannot be presented as ENVI native Clump output
limitations: Equivalence check against standard morphological closing failed in historical MATLAB archive; order of class evaluation affects boundary overwrite

claim: ERR-ENVI-STALE-PARAM: In ENVI Classic / GUI automation, rapid keyboard entry into parameter dialogs can drop fields and retain residual defaults (e.g. producing ml_thresholded.dat with 8,934 pixel difference), and unrefreshed view windows can capture stale layers unless focus is shifted before dialog capture and window title/artifact hash are verified.
source_locator: ENVI Experiment 8 Section 3 (ml_thresholded_audited.dat vs ml_thresholded.dat) & Section 6 Rules 2-3
preconditions: GUI automation or interactive screenshot capture enabled under desktop_lock
limitations: Process exit code 0 does not guarantee GUI dialog parameters were committed; output raster statistics must be cross-checked against effective_parameters

claim: Host MATLAB is R2022a (9.12.0.1884302) with base MATLAB license only (no Image Processing, Statistics and Machine Learning, or Mapping Toolbox); all MATLAB remote sensing scripts must use base matrix/binary I/O (fopen/fread/reshape) and linear algebra without calling toolbox functions.
source_locator: T01 software-probes.json & MATLAB Archive Record Section 实际流程与配置
preconditions: Verify license('test','MATLAB') == 1 and avoid toolbox-only calls (kmeans, fitcdiscr, imclose, multibandread if unsupported, geotiffread)
limitations: MATLAB Engine API for R2022a officially targets Python 3.8/3.9; when orchestrator runs on Python 3.12/3.13, invoke MATLAB via official MATLAB MCP Server or isolated batch/subprocess worker

claim: Base MATLAB Maximum Likelihood Classification (reimplementation) computes regularized Gaussian log-discriminant scores g_c(x) = -0.5*log|Sigma_c| - 0.5*(x-mu_c)'*inv(Sigma_c)*(x-mu_c) + log(P_c) with equal priors, using a fixed random seed (e.g. 20261016) and isolated training/fitting samples.
source_locator: Richards (2022) Ch. 8 & MATLAB Archive Record Section 实际流程与配置 (Items 3 & 6)
preconditions: Training samples audited for 5-pixel Chebyshev buffer from test samples
Covariance regularization epsilon documented in effective_parameters
limitations: Output rule image contains 6-class log-discriminant scores, which are unbounded log-likelihoods and must not be reported as [0,1] probabilities

claim: Base MATLAB K-Means++ and ISODATA clustering (reimplementation) must record exact RNG seed, fitting pixel subset (e.g. 60,000 pixels excluding test 11x11 neighborhoods), convergence iteration count, and actual triggered split/merge counts; untriggered split or merge branches must not be marked as verified.
source_locator: MATLAB Archive Record Section 实际流程与配置 (Item 2 & Sensitivity Analysis)
preconditions: Fixed RNG seed and explicit fitting mask isolated from evaluation points
Post-clustering ROI majority mapping recorded separately from raw cluster IDs
limitations: Sensitivity experiments using a different seed (e.g. seed 42 on full image) cannot be claimed as sharing the same isolated fitting set as the main pipeline (seed 20261016)

claim: ArcGIS Pro 3.6 (ArcInfo Advanced with Spatial and ImageAnalyst extensions) runs via its isolated Python environment; in standalone ArcPy scripts outside the GUI, ArcGISProject.activeMap and activeView return None, so project verification must use listMaps(), listLayers(), and listBrokenDataSources() after saveACopy().
preconditions: Run inside ArcGIS Pro dedicated Python environment
Verify arcpy.CheckExtension('Spatial') == 'Available' before invoking Spatial Analyst tools
limitations: Re-opening .aprx with zero broken links in a clean directory is required for project delivery acceptance; referencing temporary work paths fails verification

claim: ArcGIS Pro raster preprocessing (Clip, ProjectRaster, Resample, CompositeBands, MosaicToNewRaster) must set resampling_type='NEAREST' for categorical/class rasters to prevent fabricating intermediate class codes, and must explicitly record snapRaster, cellSize, extent, and NoData.
source_locator: ArcGIS Pro Data Management Raster Toolset: Resample & ProjectRaster
preconditions: Source raster has valid spatial reference before running ProjectRaster
Categorical rasters constrained to NEAREST resampling
limitations: Cannot run ProjectRaster on unreferenced pixel-coordinate rasters (such as can_tmr.img) without user-provided GCPs or authoritative CRS

claim: When an input remote sensing image lacks a coordinate reference system or affine map info (e.g. Canon City can_tmr.img, 640x400), coordinates must remain in local pixel space (x=col, y=H+1-row) and areas must be reported exclusively in pixel^2 and percentage; fabricating a .prj or converting to hectares/m^2 is strictly prohibited.
source_locator: MATLAB Archive Section 输入数据、坐标与样本 & ENVI Ex8 Rule 9
preconditions: Dataset audit checks header map info and CRS WKT before any spatial or area calculation
limitations: Local pixel GeoJSON exports do not conform to RFC 7946 WGS84 lon/lat coordinates and must be annotated as local pixel geometry

claim: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance scale factor (SR = 0.0000275 * DN - 0.2) applies only when official MTL/product metadata confirms Collection 2 L2 uint16 input; for unverified byte rasters (such as can_tmr.img with values 0-100), computations and reports must use stored numeric values without inventing scale factors.
source_locator: USGS Landsat C2 Scale Factor FAQ & Notion Spec 02 Section 9
preconditions: Verify product level, data type (uint16 vs uint8), and explicit scale/offset metadata before radiometric scaling
limitations: Additive offsets change band ratios if applied inconsistently; indices on unverified byte data must document storage-unit basis

claim: ERR-UNVERIFIED-REFLECTANCE-UNIT: Free-text header descriptions stating 'calibrated reflectance' (as in can_tmr.hdr) without verified radiometric scale factor and sensor calibration metadata conflict with strict physical unit requirements and must not be reported as physical surface reflectance [0,1].
source_locator: can_tmr.hdr description vs Notion Spec 02 Section 9
preconditions: Header description contains reflectance wording while numeric storage is uint8 0-100 without scale factor field
limitations: Requires explicit disclaimer in dataset audit and experiment report

claim: Spectral index computation (NDVI=(TM4-TM3)/(TM4+TM3), NDWI=(TM2-TM4)/(TM2+TM4), MNDWI=(TM2-TM5)/(TM2+TM5), and band ratios) must cast integer bands to floating-point prior to division, replace zero denominators with explicit NoData (-9999.0), and for 6-band TM files map file band 6 to TM7; in Landsat 5 TM Tasseled Cap (K-T), the 3rd axis must be termed 'wetness-related third component (Third)' rather than 'Wetness'.
source_locator: USGS NDVI, McFeeters (1996), Xu (2006), Crist & Cicone (1984), ENVI Ex8 Section 3 & Rule 6
preconditions: Verify band order (e.g. can_tmr.img b1..b6 = TM1, TM2, TM3, TM4, TM5, TM7)
Cast uint8/uint16 to float32 or float64 before arithmetic
limitations: Integer division truncates normalized indices to -1, 0, or 1
Unmasked zero denominators produce NaN/Inf that corrupt downstream decision trees

claim: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on multi-band imagery must record whether covariance (unstandardized) or correlation (standardized) matrix is used, isolate the fitting sample mask if sub-sampled, fix sign orientation or record eigenvectors, and report per-component eigenvalues and explained variance ratios.
source_locator: Richards (2022) Ch. 6 Principal Components & ENVI Forward PC Rotation Help
preconditions: Exclude NoData pixels before computing band means and covariance/correlation matrix
limitations: Eigenvector sign is arbitrary up to +/-1 across software implementations; comparison must check absolute correlation or subspace projection error

claim: Classification accuracy verification must map native_code to semantic_id before building an asymmetric confusion matrix (reference vs predicted + unclassified), verify Producer's Accuracy (PA = diag / reference_total) and User's Accuracy (UA = diag / predicted_total) without axis transposition, check Chebyshev spatial buffers between train and test ROIs, and strictly label evaluation_kind as diagnostic, reference_agreement, or independent.
source_locator: Olofsson et al. (2014), Roberts et al. (2017), Congalton (1991), Notion Spec 02 Section 9
preconditions: Explicit class mapping table linking native_code to semantic_id (e.g. resolving MATLAB 3=construction,4=water,5=bare vs ENVI 3=bare,4=construction,5=water)
Separate tracking of unclassified pixels (code 0) from 'other' land cover (code 6)
limitations: Once reference points are used to diagnose errors or tune training samples/thresholds, subsequent evaluations on the same points are diagnostic re-evaluation (diagnostic), not independent test accuracy
